# gb2 — execution independence and omp-side lifecycle

**Re-run result: PASS for all five requested criteria under the resolved gate rules.** Earlier gate result, preserved as history: **FAIL.** Delayed old terminals bind the current generation; native overflow loses the required reason for 12 children; the real git-URL installer rejects the fixture URL. Strict native-byte/context equality also fails the observer-absent control. The dated re-run below supersedes those requested criteria; unrelated earlier results and limits stand.

Assignment: `docs/maintainers/omp-orca-bridge-slices/gb2-independence-lifecycle.md` (snapshot 529A). Write ownership is this evidence file only. Baseline: this file was absent (glob); directory has no applicable `@cc` contracts (ncm list). Recovery is removal of this newly-created evidence file; no existing file is replaced.

All omp processes use harness-created disposable HOME, TMPDIR, XDG roots and repositories, and the local stub provider. Real package and binaries remain unchanged. Fault-injected packages and scripts are disposable under `<tmp>`. No Orca commands, live credentials, formatting, linting, or project-wide checks are used.

Installer contract: supplied `local://omp-plugin-plumbing-v18.3.5.md`, source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/v18.3.5/docs/plugin-manager-installer-plumbing.md (install 100–114; uninstall 124–133; link 148–163; discovery 166–180; state 206–222; rollback 250–263). Inspected dev source `node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/src/extensibility/plugins/manager.ts:447-455,871-885`: install accepts git/package specs; disabling writes the runtime config's `enabled` flag. No extension-disable callback is assumed.

Results are recorded incrementally below. A FAIL is a gate failure, not authorization to fix production. Unobserved paths are explicitly unverified.

Installed binary: `omp --profile one-child --version`, launched by harness `create('one-child')`, exit 0, stdout `omp/18.4.4`, stderr empty.

Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" matrix` (exit 0; the driver reports comparisons, not an assertion-based success). All native task scenarios completed, with `child-one` idle and output `"child complete"`. Observer states were exercised with absent, disabled, enabled, 200-ms reconcile busy-wait, throwing collect, throwing bus callback and forced-incompatible copies.

**v03 native byte equality: FAIL / baseline nondeterminism.** The observer-absent repeat also differs.   output('REMOVE_INITIAL', normResult(await p.run(['plugin', 'uninstall', 'omp-orca-observer']))); git = await startGitSource(); output('GIT_INSTALL', { command: 'omp --profile one-child plugin install ' + normalize(git.url), ...normResult(await p.run(['plugin', 'install', git.url])) }); output('PLUGIN_LIST', normResult(await p.run(['plugin', 'list'])));
  const sibling = join(p.root, 'sibling'); await mkdir(sibling); await writeFile(join(sibling, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({ name: 'gb2-sibling', version: '1.0.0', type: 'module', omp: { extensions: ['index.ts'] } })); await writeFile(join(sibling, 'index.ts'), `export default function(api){api.registerCommand('sibling',{description:'Disposable sibling',handler:(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_SIBLING unchanged','info')});}`); output('SIBLING_LINK', normResult(await p.run(['plugin', 'link', sibling])));
  for (const action of ['disable', 'uninstall']) { output('RELINK', normResult(await p.run(['plugin', 'link', packageRoot]))); let rpc = await launch(p, packageRoot); try { await Bun.sleep(500); output('LOADED', { action, report: stable(await rpc.report()), sibling: await rpc.command('/sibling') }); output('ACTION', { action, ...normResult(await p.run(['plugin', action, 'omp-orca-observer'])) }); output('SAME_PROCESS_NEW', { action, result: await rpc.request('new_session') }); await Bun.sleep(500); output('SAME_PROCESS', { action, report: stable(await rpc.report()), sibling: await rpc.command('/sibling') }); await rpc.close(); rpc = await launch(p, packageRoot); await Bun.sleep(500); output('FRESH_PROCESS', { action, report: stable(await rpc.report()), sibling: await rpc.command('/sibling') }); } finally { await rpc.close(); } }
 } finally { await git?.stop(); await p.teardown(); }
}
try { if (stage === 'matrix') await matrix(); else if (stage === 'callbacks') await callbacks('many-135', 'enabled'); else if (stage === 'overflow') await callbacks('many-33', 'overflow'); else if (stage === 'nested' || stage === 'restricted') await callbacks(stage, 'enabled'); else if (stage === 'install') await install(); else await lifecycle(stage); } catch (e) { output('GATE_ERROR', { stage, error: normalize(String(e)), stack: normalize(e instanceof Error ? e.stack ?? '' : '') }); process.exitCode = 1; }
appendFileSync(evidence, '\n```\n\nRunner exit status: ' + (process.exitCode ?? 0) + '. Profiles and package copies are torn down in `finally`.\n');

```typescript
 c.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id: 'state', type: 'get_state' }) + '\n');
```

### gb2-rpc-discover.ts source (bootstrap)

```typescript
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path';
import { writeFile, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
// Runtime-selected checkout path keeps this disposable script relocatable.
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const { create } = await import(resolve(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/harness/profile.ts'));
const p = await create('one-child');
const ext = join(p.root, 'probe.ts');
await writeFile(ext,`export default function(api) {
 api.on('session_start',(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_START '+JSON.stringify({agent:ctx.agent,file:ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()}),'info'));
 api.registerCommand('gb2',{description:'Disposable probe',handler:(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_REFS '+JSON.stringify(api.pi.AgentRegistry.global().list().map(r=>({id:r.id,parentId:r.parentId,kind:r.kind,status:r.status,sessionFile:r.sessionFile}))),'info')});
}`);
const c = p.spawn(['--mode', 'rpc', '--no-title', '--no-lsp', '--extension', ext]);
const events: any[] = []; let buf = '';
const read = (async () => { for await (const bytes of c.stdout) { buf += new TextDecoder().decode(bytes); let at; while ((at = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) { const line = buf.slice(0, at); buf = buf.slice(at + 1); try { const e = JSON.parse(line); events.push(e); if (['ready', 'response', 'extension_ui_request', 'error'].includes(e.type)) console.log(JSON.stringify(e).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); else console.log('EVENT ' + e.type); } catch { console.log('NONJSON ' + line.replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); } } } })();
const stderr = new Response(c.stderr).text();
async function wait(pred, timeout = 30000) { const end = Date.now() + timeout; while (Date.now() < end) { const found = events.find(pred); if (found) return found; await Bun.sleep(20); } throw Error('WAIT_TIMEOUT'); }
async function request(type, rest = {}) { const id = 'request-' + events.length; c.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id, type, ...rest }) + '\n'); return wait(e => e.type === 'response' && e.id === id); }
try {
 await wait(e => e.type === 'ready');
 await request('get_state'); await request('get_commands');
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: 'HARNESS_AGENT=main' });
 await wait(e => e.type === 'agent_end', 60000); await Bun.sleep(600);
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: '/observer serve' });
 await request('new_session'); await request('get_state');
} catch (e) { console.log('DISCOVERY_ERROR ' + String(e)); }
finally { c.kill(); await c.exited; await read; console.log('STDERR ' + (await stderr).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); console.log('CAPTURE ' + (await readFile(p.capture, 'utf8')).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); await p.teardown(); }
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```typescript
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path';
import { writeFile, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
// Runtime-selected checkout path keeps this disposable script relocatable.
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const { create } = await import(resolve(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/harness/profile.ts'));
const p = await create('one-child');
const ext = join(p.root, 'probe.ts');
await writeFile(ext,`export default function(api) {
 api.on('session_start',(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_START '+JSON.stringify({agent:ctx.agent,file:ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()}),'info'));
 api.registerCommand('gb2',{description:'Disposable probe',handler:(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_REFS '+JSON.stringify(api.pi.AgentRegistry.global().list().map(r=>({id:r.id,parentId:r.parentId,kind:r.kind,status:r.status,sessionFile:r.sessionFile}))),'info')});
}`);
const c = p.spawn(['--mode', 'rpc', '--no-title', '--no-lsp', '--extension', ext]);
const events: any[] = []; let buf = '';
const read = (async () => { for await (const bytes of c.stdout) { buf += new TextDecoder().decode(bytes); let at; while ((at = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) { const line = buf.slice(0, at); buf = buf.slice(at + 1); try { const e = JSON.parse(line); events.push(e); if (['ready', 'response', 'extension_ui_request', 'error'].includes(e.type)) console.log(JSON.stringify(e).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); else console.log('EVENT ' + e.type); } catch { console.log('NONJSON ' + line.replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); } } } })();
const stderr = new Response(c.stderr).text();
async function wait(pred, timeout = 30000) { const end = Date.now() + timeout; while (Date.now() < end) { const found = events.find(pred); if (found) return found; await Bun.sleep(20); } throw Error('WAIT_TIMEOUT'); }
async function request(type, rest = {}) { const id = 'request-' + events.length; c.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id, type, ...rest }) + '\n'); return wait(e => e.type === 'response' && e.id === id); }
try {
 await wait(e => e.type === 'ready');
 await request('get_state'); await request('get_commands');
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: 'HARNESS_AGENT=main' });
 await wait(e => e.type === 'agent_end', 60000); await Bun.sleep(600);
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: '/observer serve' });
 await request('new_session'); await request('get_state');
} catch (e) { console.log('DISCOVERY_ERROR ' + String(e)); }
finally { c.kill(); await c.exited; await read; console.log('STDERR ' + (await stderr).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); console.log('CAPTURE ' + (await readFile(p.capture, 'utf8')).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); await p.teardown(); }
```

async function launch(p: any, modulePath: string, args: string[] = []) {

}

async function native(p: any, rpc: any, report: any) {

async function lifecycle(name: string) {

}
async function install() {

'' : '') }); process.exitCode = 1; }
appendFileSync(evidence, '\n```\n\nRunner exit status: ' + (process.exitCode ?? 0) + '. Profiles and package copies are torn down in `finally`.\n');

```typescript
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path';
import { writeFile, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
// Runtime-selected checkout path keeps this disposable script relocatable.
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const { create } = await import(resolve(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/harness/profile.ts'));
const p = await create('one-child');
const ext = join(p.root, 'probe.ts');
await writeFile(ext,`export default function(api) {
 api.on('session_start',(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_START '+JSON.stringify({agent:ctx.agent,file:ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()}),'info'));
 api.registerCommand('gb2',{description:'Disposable probe',handler:(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_REFS '+JSON.stringify(api.pi.AgentRegistry.global().list().map(r=>({id:r.id,parentId:r.parentId,kind:r.kind,status:r.status,sessionFile:r.sessionFile}))),'info')});
}`);
const c = p.spawn(['--mode', 'rpc', '--no-title', '--no-lsp', '--extension', ext]);
const events: any[] = []; let buf = '';
const read = (async () => { for await (const bytes of c.stdout) { buf += new TextDecoder().decode(bytes); let at; while ((at = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) { const line = buf.slice(0, at); buf = buf.slice(at + 1); try { const e = JSON.parse(line); events.push(e); if (['ready', 'response', 'extension_ui_request', 'error'].includes(e.type)) console.log(JSON.stringify(e).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); else console.log('EVENT ' + e.type); } catch { console.log('NONJSON ' + line.replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); } } } })();
const stderr = new Response(c.stderr).text();
async function wait(pred, timeout = 30000) { const end = Date.now() + timeout; while (Date.now() < end) { const found = events.find(pred); if (found) return found; await Bun.sleep(20); } throw Error('WAIT_TIMEOUT'); }
async function request(type, rest = {}) { const id = 'request-' + events.length; c.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id, type, ...rest }) + '\n'); return wait(e => e.type === 'response' && e.id === id); }
try {
 await wait(e => e.type === 'ready');
 await request('get_state'); await request('get_commands');
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: 'HARNESS_AGENT=main' });
 await wait(e => e.type === 'agent_end', 60000); await Bun.sleep(600);
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: '/observer serve' });
 await request('new_session'); await request('get_state');
} catch (e) { console.log('DISCOVERY_ERROR ' + String(e)); }
finally { c.kill(); await c.exited; await read; console.log('STDERR ' + (await stderr).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); console.log('CAPTURE ' + (await readFile(p.capture, 'utf8')).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); await p.teardown(); }
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

## Computed measurement and lifecycle summaries

Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2-summarize.mjs "$PWD"`. This reducer consumes the captured lines already present above, and does not launch omp or access any package source.

```javascript
import { readFile, appendFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const evidence = join(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/evidence/gb2.md');
const text = await readFile(evidence, 'utf8');
const rows = [];
for (const line of text.split('\n')) { const n = line.indexOf(' '); if (n < 0) continue; const tag = line.slice(0, n); if (!['MATRIX', 'CALLBACKS', 'BEFORE', 'AFTER_OLD_FACT', 'RESUMED', 'AFTER_RELOAD', 'RESTORE_SAMPLE', 'RESTART_TOKEN', 'GIT_INSTALL', 'LOADED', 'SAME_PROCESS', 'FRESH_PROCESS', 'LIFECYCLE_LOG'].includes(tag)) continue; try { rows.push({ tag, value: JSON.parse(line.slice(n + 1)) }); } catch { } }
const counts = values => { const out = {}; for (const v of values) out[v] = (out[v] ?? 0) + 1; return out; };
const summary = [];
for (const { tag, value: r } of rows) {
 if (tag === 'MATRIX') summary.push({ tag: 'MATRIX_SUMMARY', mode: r.mode, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, state: r.report.state, networkOperations: r.observerIo.filter(x => x.kind.startsWith('network.')).length, transcriptReads: r.observerIo.filter(x => x.kind === 'fs.open' || x.kind === 'fs.handle.read' || x.kind === 'fs.readFileSync').length, ioCounts: counts(r.observerIo.map(x => x.kind)), childStatuses: counts(r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').map(x => x.status)), contexts: r.contexts.map(x => ({ agent: x.agent, model: x.model, messages: x.messages })) });
 if (tag === 'CALLBACKS') {
  const children = r.report.snapshot?.children ?? [];
  summary.push({ tag: 'CALLBACK_SUMMARY', name: r.name, mode: r.mode, metrics: r.metrics, heap: r.heap, epoch: r.report.epoch, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, refs: r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').length, children: children.length, registryStatuses: counts(children.map(x => x.registryStatus)), outcomes: counts(children.map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)), frames: r.frames?.map(g => ({ count: g.count, inventory: g.frame.inventory, outcomes: counts((g.frame.children ?? []).map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)) })) });
 }

[]).map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)) });

 if (tag === 'GIT_INSTALL') summary.push({ tag: 'GIT_INSTALL_SUMMARY', ...r });
}
const output = summary.map(x => JSON.stringify(x)).join('\n') + '\n';
console.log(output);
await appendFile(evidence, '\n## Computed measurement and lifecycle summaries\n\nCommand: `bun <tmp>/gb2-summarize.mjs "$PWD"`. ## v03 criterion results — listener, I/O, measurements and overflow
```

- **One publisher registry listener and child shutdown: PASS.** Commands: `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" nested` and `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" restricted`, both exit 0. Native child extension runners explicitly dispatch `session_shutdown` after their assignments finish (not merely a simulated callback). Listener active/peak are both 1; shutdown preserves epoch and snapshot.

```text

```

- **No `/observer serve`, no observer network/transcript reads: PASS for the matrix.** Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" matrix`, exit 0. The attributable wrapper records only observer `fs`/`Bun.file`/`Bun.serve`/`fetch` callsites and file/dir-handle methods, not omp's parse cache, provider traffic, or the bookkeeping log. All modes have `networkOperations:0` and `transcriptReads:0`. Enabled/slow/throwBus perform one tombstone stat, one directory open, three directory reads and one directory close; these are metadata enumeration, not transcript reads. ThrowCollect and incompatible have empty I/O logs.

- **Callback CPU, heap growth and every collect cost: PASS (measurement criterion).** Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" callbacks`, exit 0, native `many-135` completes all 135 children. 540 registry callbacks: 13,535 µs CPU, 13.431457 ms wall total, 0.109393 ms maximum. 270 lifecycle callbacks: 16,769 µs CPU, 8.849825 ms wall total, 0.260830 ms maximum. 38 collects: 105,866 µs CPU, 79.437433 ms wall total, 9.887744 ms maximum. Every collect's wall/CPU/heap delta is retained in `CALLBACK_SUMMARY` and the full captured run. Whole-process heap: 90,105,462 → 241,086,469 bytes (+150,981,007), peak 241,086,469. This is not observer-only retained memory: it includes native sessions, instrumentation, and uncontrolled GC. CPU uses process counters bracketing callbacks/collects, and includes counter/proxy overhead and possible background native CPU; no zero-overhead timing claim is made. Collection includes the full-registry copy, row building and attributable metadata I/O, not a separated copy-only benchmark.

- **Overflow outcomes: FAIL for the required reason; safety subcondition observed.** Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" overflow`, exit 0, real `many-33` with queue capacity 2. Final native rows are all 33 idle; 21 observer outcomes are `unknown("fact queue overflow")`, but 12 are `unknown("no lifecycle evidence")`. Intermediate snapshots also report `unknown("terminal without observed start")`. Thus the required overflow reason does not cover every affected child. No terminal observer outcome occurs in the recorded overflow snapshot sequence. The scenario has no second native assignment to the same child, so native recovery at the next `started` remains unverified.

### Probe limitations and recovered scratch artifact

The first matrix probe imported `coordinator.ts` independently; omp's extension loader uses a distinct module instance, so those probe reports cannot prove coordinator epoch/state. Their native results, stub digests, listener counts and attributable I/O remain observations. Subsequent fault copies expose the loaded coordinator through an explicit disposable global getter; its diff is retained.

The initial probe incorrectly placed its own `control-probe.jsonl` at `$PWD/control-probe.jsonl` for non-copy modes. This was an unintended supporting-file write outside the evidence boundary, not product/session mutation; it was discovered via glob and removed with `rm -- control-probe.jsonl <tmp>/gb2-record-bootstrap.ts` (exit 0, no output). The latter unused script was never executed. The control path now comes exclusively from the harness profile. No real package file was edited.

One launch was not run because the tool reported `worktree mutation busy after 5.0s` with sibling `Gb1Gate` holding the bash lease. A later launch succeeded; this is a tool scheduling limitation, not a gate pass.

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2.ts "$PWD" install` | harness `one-child`, unmodified omp 18.4.4, disposable GitSource and stub | runner exit 0; individual installer exit below | no fallback URL/package spec was attempted.

- **Real git-url install/validation: FAIL.** Exact native command uses the URL supplied by `startGitSource()`, with only the ephemeral port normalized:


The real installer rejects this URL before installation; package validation via that path therefore stays unverified. Native `plugin list` subsequently prints `No plugins installed`. The GitSource's fixture commit is confined to its disposable copy.

- **Link: PASS.** `omp --profile one-child plugin link "$PWD/omp-orca-observer"` exits 0, stdout `✔ Linked omp-orca-observer from $PWD/omp-orca-observer`, stderr empty. Native process startup registers the publisher's sole observer registry listener.

- **Disable sequence: PASS.** Loaded process has active/peak listener 1; `omp --profile one-child plugin disable omp-orca-observer` exits 0 (`✔ Disabled omp-orca-observer`). RPC `new_session` returns `{"cancelled":false}` in that same process, which still has active listener 1. Fresh process has active/peak listener 0. This matches the resolved rule that disabling is persisted discovery state, not an immediate extension-disable callback.

- **Uninstall sequence: PASS for a linked package.** After relinking: loaded active/peak 1; `omp --profile one-child plugin uninstall omp-orca-observer` exits 0 (`✔ Uninstalled omp-orca-observer`); same-process RPC `new_session` succeeds and retains active listener 1; fresh process has active/peak 0. Uninstall of a successfully git-installed package cannot be claimed because the git install failed.

- **Sibling extension: PASS for the exercised sibling.** The disposable sibling command's exact notification remains `GB2_SIBLING unchanged` in the loaded, same-process-after-`/new`, and fresh process for both disable and uninstall. Its registration, factory and manifest are embedded in the runner source. No production sibling extension was altered or accessed.

async function install() {

}

'' : '') }); process.exitCode = 1; }

```typescript
 }

 c.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id: 'state', type: 'get_state' }) + '\n');

 console.log(new TextDecoder().decode(next.value));
 c.kill(); await c.exited;
} finally { await p.teardown(); }
```

```typescript
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path';
import { writeFile, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
// Runtime-selected checkout path keeps this disposable script relocatable.
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const { create } = await import(resolve(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/harness/profile.ts'));
const p = await create('one-child');
const ext = join(p.root, 'probe.ts');
await writeFile(ext,`export default function(api) {
 api.on('session_start',(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_START '+JSON.stringify({agent:ctx.agent,file:ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()}),'info'));
 api.registerCommand('gb2',{description:'Disposable probe',handler:(_,ctx)=>ctx.ui.notify('GB2_REFS '+JSON.stringify(api.pi.AgentRegistry.global().list().map(r=>({id:r.id,parentId:r.parentId,kind:r.kind,status:r.status,sessionFile:r.sessionFile}))),'info')});
}`);
const c = p.spawn(['--mode', 'rpc', '--no-title', '--no-lsp', '--extension', ext]);
const events: any[] = []; let buf = '';
const read = (async () => { for await (const bytes of c.stdout) { buf += new TextDecoder().decode(bytes); let at; while ((at = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) { const line = buf.slice(0, at); buf = buf.slice(at + 1); try { const e = JSON.parse(line); events.push(e); if (['ready', 'response', 'extension_ui_request', 'error'].includes(e.type)) console.log(JSON.stringify(e).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); else console.log('EVENT ' + e.type); } catch { console.log('NONJSON ' + line.replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); } } } })();
const stderr = new Response(c.stderr).text();
async function wait(pred, timeout = 30000) { const end = Date.now() + timeout; while (Date.now() < end) { const found = events.find(pred); if (found) return found; await Bun.sleep(20); } throw Error('WAIT_TIMEOUT'); }
async function request(type, rest = {}) { const id = 'request-' + events.length; c.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id, type, ...rest }) + '\n'); return wait(e => e.type === 'response' && e.id === id); }
try {
 await wait(e => e.type === 'ready');
 await request('get_state'); await request('get_commands');
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: 'HARNESS_AGENT=main' });
 await wait(e => e.type === 'agent_end', 60000); await Bun.sleep(600);
 await request('prompt', { message: '/gb2' });
 await request('prompt', { message: '/observer serve' });
 await request('new_session'); await request('get_state');
} catch (e) { console.log('DISCOVERY_ERROR ' + String(e)); }
finally { c.kill(); await c.exited; await read; console.log('STDERR ' + (await stderr).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); console.log('CAPTURE ' + (await readFile(p.capture, 'utf8')).replaceAll(p.root, '<profile>')); await p.teardown(); }
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

## Computed measurement and lifecycle summaries

Command: `bun <tmp>/gb2-summarize.mjs "$PWD"`. This reducer consumes the captured lines already present above, and does not launch omp or access any package source.

```javascript
import { readFile, appendFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const evidence = join(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/evidence/gb2.md');
const text = await readFile(evidence, 'utf8');
const rows = [];
for (const line of text.split('\n')) { const n = line.indexOf(' '); if (n < 0) continue; const tag = line.slice(0, n); if (!['MATRIX', 'CALLBACKS', 'BEFORE', 'AFTER_OLD_FACT', 'NEW_ROOT_CHILD', 'RESUMED', 'AFTER_RELOAD', 'RELOAD_TOKEN', 'REMOVED_STATE', 'REMOVED_ENDPOINT', 'RELINKED_STATE', 'RESTORE_SAMPLE', 'RESTART_TOKEN', 'GIT_INSTALL', 'LOADED', 'SAME_PROCESS', 'FRESH_PROCESS', 'LIFECYCLE_LOG'].includes(tag)) continue; try { rows.push({ tag, value: JSON.parse(line.slice(n + 1)) }); } catch { } }
const counts = values => { const out = {}; for (const v of values) out[v] = (out[v] ?? 0) + 1; return out; };
const summary = [];
for (const { tag, value: r } of rows) {
 if (tag === 'MATRIX') summary.push({ tag: 'MATRIX_SUMMARY', mode: r.mode, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, state: r.report.state, networkOperations: r.observerIo.filter(x => x.kind.startsWith('network.')).length, transcriptReads: r.observerIo.filter(x => x.kind === 'fs.open' || x.kind === 'fs.handle.read' || x.kind === 'fs.readFileSync').length, ioCounts: counts(r.observerIo.map(x => x.kind)), childStatuses: counts(r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').map(x => x.status)), contexts: r.contexts.map(x => ({ agent: x.agent, model: x.model, messages: x.messages })) });
 if (tag === 'CALLBACKS') {
  const children = r.report.snapshot?.children ?? [];
  summary.push({ tag: 'CALLBACK_SUMMARY', name: r.name, mode: r.mode, metrics: r.metrics, heap: r.heap, epoch: r.report.epoch, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, refs: r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').length, children: children.length, registryStatuses: counts(children.map(x => x.registryStatus)), outcomes: counts(children.map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)), frames: r.frames?.map(g => ({ count: g.count, inventory: g.frame.inventory, outcomes: counts((g.frame.children ?? []).map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)) })) });
 }
 if (['BEFORE', 'AFTER_OLD_FACT', 'NEW_ROOT_CHILD', 'RESUMED', 'AFTER_RELOAD', 'LOADED', 'SAME_PROCESS', 'FRESH_PROCESS'].includes(tag)) summary.push({ tag: tag + '_SUMMARY', name: r.name, action: r.action, epoch: r.report.epoch, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, inventory: r.report.snapshot?.inventory, children: r.report.snapshot?.children.map(x => ({ id: x.childId, status: x.registryStatus, tombstoned: x.tombstoned, outcome: x.outcome })), page: r.page, oldTokenStatus: r.oldTokenStatus, oldTokenReset: r.oldTokenOutput?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.oldTokenOutput).reset : r.oldTokenOutput, sibling: r.sibling?.filter(x => x.type === 'extension_ui_request').map(x => x.message) });
 if (tag === 'RESTORE_SAMPLE') summary.push({ tag: 'RESTORE_SUMMARY', name: r.name, epoch: r.epoch, inventory: r.inventory, children: r.children?.length, refs: r.refs.length, outcomes: counts((r.children ?? []).map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)) });
 if (tag === 'RESTART_TOKEN') summary.push({ tag: 'RESTART_TOKEN_SUMMARY', name: r.name, status: r.status, kind: r.output?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.output).kind : r.output, reset: r.output?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.output).reset : null });
 if (tag === 'RELOAD_TOKEN') summary.push({ tag: 'RELOAD_TOKEN_SUMMARY', status: r.status, reset: r.output?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.output).reset : null });
 if (tag === 'REMOVED_STATE') summary.push({ tag, epoch: r.epoch, active: r.active, snapshot: r.snapshot });
 if (tag === 'REMOVED_ENDPOINT') summary.push({ tag, ...r });
 if (tag === 'RELINKED_STATE') summary.push({ tag: 'RELINKED_SUMMARY', epoch: r.report.epoch, active: r.report.active, inventory: r.report.snapshot?.inventory, children: r.report.snapshot?.children.map(x => x.childId), tokenStatus: r.tokenStatus, tokenReset: r.tokenOutput?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.tokenOutput).reset : null });
 if (tag === 'LIFECYCLE_LOG') summary.push({ tag: 'INVENTORY_FRAMES_SUMMARY', name: r.name, epochs: [...new Set(r.inventoryFrames.map(x => x.epoch))], inventories: counts(r.inventoryFrames.map(x => JSON.stringify(x.inventory))), refCounts: counts(r.inventoryFrames.map(x => x.children?.length)) });
 if (tag === 'GIT_INSTALL') summary.push({ tag: 'GIT_INSTALL_SUMMARY', ...r });
}
const output = summary.map(x => JSON.stringify(x)).join('\n') + '\n';
console.log(output);
await appendFile(evidence, '\n## Computed measurement and lifecycle summaries\n\nCommand: `bun <tmp>/gb2-summarize.mjs "$PWD"`. This reducer consumes the captured lines already present above, and does not launch omp or access any package source.\n\n```javascript\n' + await readFile(process.argv[1], 'utf8') + '\n```\n\n```text\n' + output + '```\n');
```

function extensionSource(modulePath: string, probePath: string) {

const key=Symbol.for('gb2.probe');const shared=globalThis[key]??=( {active:0,peak:0,events:[],heapStart:0,heapPeak:0,frames:[]} );
const path=${JSON.stringify(probePath)};
function save(kind,data){fs.appendFileSync(path,JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\\n');}
export default function(api){
 const registry=api.pi.AgentRegistry.global();
 if(!registry[key]){registry[key]=true;const old=registry.onChange.bind(registry);registry.onChange=callback=>{const observer=new Error().stack?.includes('stock-source.ts');if(observer){shared.active++;shared.peak=Math.max(shared.peak,shared.active);save('listener_add',{active:shared.active});}const off=old(callback);return ()=>{off();if(observer){shared.active--;save('listener_remove',{active:shared.active});}};};}
 api.on('session_start',(_,ctx)=>{if(ctx.agent.kind==='main'){shared.heapStart=process.memoryUsage().heapUsed;shared.heapPeak=shared.heapStart;const timer=setInterval(()=>{shared.heapPeak=Math.max(shared.heapPeak,process.memoryUsage().heapUsed);const c=processCoordinator();if(c)save('frame',{epoch:c.epoch(),state:c.state(),snapshot:c.snapshot(),active:shared.active});},100);timer.unref();}save('start',{agent:ctx.agent,epoch:processCoordinator()?.epoch(),file:ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()});});
 api.registerCommand('gb2inspect',{description:'Disposable runtime shape inspection',handler:(_,ctx)=>{const child=registry.list().find(r=>r.kind==='sub');const session=child?.session;const runner=session?.extensionRunner;ctx.ui.notify('GB2_INSPECT '+JSON.stringify({ctxKeys:Object.keys(ctx),sessionKeys:session?Object.keys(session):[],sessionMethods:session?Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Object.getPrototypeOf(session)):[],runnerKeys:runner?Object.keys(runner):[],runnerMethods:runner?Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Object.getPrototypeOf(runner)):[]}), 'info');}});
 api.on('session_shutdown',(_,ctx)=>save('shutdown',{agent:ctx.agent,epoch:processCoordinator()?.epoch(),active:shared.active}));

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```javascript
import { readFile, appendFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const repo = process.argv[2] ?? process.cwd();
const evidence = join(repo, 'omp-orca-observer/checks/evidence/gb2.md');
const text = await readFile(evidence, 'utf8');
const rows = [];
for (const line of text.split('\n')) { const n = line.indexOf(' '); if (n < 0) continue; const tag = line.slice(0, n); if (!['MATRIX', 'CALLBACKS', 'BEFORE', 'AFTER_OLD_FACT', 'NEW_ROOT_CHILD', 'RESUMED', 'AFTER_RELOAD', 'RELOAD_TOKEN', 'REMOVED_STATE', 'REMOVED_ENDPOINT', 'RELINKED_STATE', 'RESTORE_SAMPLE', 'RESTART_TOKEN', 'GIT_INSTALL', 'LOADED', 'SAME_PROCESS', 'FRESH_PROCESS', 'LIFECYCLE_LOG'].includes(tag)) continue; try { rows.push({ tag, value: JSON.parse(line.slice(n + 1)) }); } catch { } }
const counts = values => { const out = {}; for (const v of values) out[v] = (out[v] ?? 0) + 1; return out; };
const summary = [];
for (const { tag, value: r } of rows) {
 if (tag === 'MATRIX') summary.push({ tag: 'MATRIX_SUMMARY', mode: r.mode, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, state: r.report.state, networkOperations: r.observerIo.filter(x => x.kind.startsWith('network.')).length, transcriptReads: r.observerIo.filter(x => x.kind === 'fs.open' || x.kind === 'fs.handle.read' || x.kind === 'fs.readFileSync').length, ioCounts: counts(r.observerIo.map(x => x.kind)), childStatuses: counts(r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').map(x => x.status)), contexts: r.contexts.map(x => ({ agent: x.agent, model: x.model, messages: x.messages })) });
 if (tag === 'CALLBACKS') {
  const children = r.report.snapshot?.children ?? [];
  summary.push({ tag: 'CALLBACK_SUMMARY', name: r.name, mode: r.mode, metrics: r.metrics, heap: r.heap, epoch: r.report.epoch, observerState: r.report.state, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, refs: r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').length, nativeRegistryStatuses: counts(r.report.refs.filter(x => x.kind === 'sub').map(x => x.status)), children: children.length, registryStatuses: counts(children.map(x => x.registryStatus)), outcomes: counts(children.map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)), frames: r.frames?.map(g => ({ count: g.count, inventory: g.frame.inventory, outcomes: counts((g.frame.children ?? []).map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)) })) });
 }
 if (['BEFORE', 'AFTER_OLD_FACT', 'NEW_ROOT_CHILD', 'RESUMED', 'AFTER_RELOAD', 'LOADED', 'SAME_PROCESS', 'FRESH_PROCESS'].includes(tag)) summary.push({ tag: tag + '_SUMMARY', name: r.name, action: r.action, epoch: r.report.epoch, active: r.report.active, peak: r.report.peak, inventory: r.report.snapshot?.inventory, children: r.report.snapshot?.children.map(x => ({ id: x.childId, status: x.registryStatus, tombstoned: x.tombstoned, outcome: x.outcome })), page: r.page, oldTokenStatus: r.oldTokenStatus, oldTokenReset: r.oldTokenOutput?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.oldTokenOutput).reset : r.oldTokenOutput, sibling: r.sibling?.filter(x => x.type === 'extension_ui_request').map(x => x.message) });
 if (tag === 'RESTORE_SAMPLE') summary.push({ tag: 'RESTORE_SUMMARY', name: r.name, epoch: r.epoch, inventory: r.inventory, children: r.children?.length, refs: r.refs.length, outcomes: counts((r.children ?? []).map(x => x.outcome.state === 'unknown' ? x.outcome.state + '(' + x.outcome.reason + ')' : x.outcome.state)) });
 if (tag === 'RESTART_TOKEN') summary.push({ tag: 'RESTART_TOKEN_SUMMARY', name: r.name, status: r.status, kind: r.output?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.output).kind : r.output, reset: r.output?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.output).reset : null });
 if (tag === 'RELOAD_TOKEN') summary.push({ tag: 'RELOAD_TOKEN_SUMMARY', status: r.status, reset: r.output?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.output).reset : null });
 if (tag === 'REMOVED_STATE') summary.push({ tag, epoch: r.epoch, active: r.active, snapshot: r.snapshot });
 if (tag === 'REMOVED_ENDPOINT') summary.push({ tag, ...r });
 if (tag === 'RELINKED_STATE') summary.push({ tag: 'RELINKED_SUMMARY', epoch: r.report.epoch, active: r.report.active, inventory: r.report.snapshot?.inventory, children: r.report.snapshot?.children.map(x => x.childId), tokenStatus: r.tokenStatus, tokenReset: r.tokenOutput?.startsWith('{') ? JSON.parse(r.tokenOutput).reset : null });
 if (tag === 'LIFECYCLE_LOG') summary.push({ tag: 'INVENTORY_FRAMES_SUMMARY', name: r.name, epochs: [...new Set(r.inventoryFrames.map(x => x.epoch))], inventories: counts(r.inventoryFrames.map(x => JSON.stringify(x.inventory))), refCounts: counts(r.inventoryFrames.map(x => x.children?.length)) });
 if (tag === 'GIT_INSTALL') summary.push({ tag: 'GIT_INSTALL_SUMMARY', ...r });
}
const output = summary.map(x => JSON.stringify(x)).join('\n') + '\n';
console.log(output);
await appendFile(evidence, '\n## Computed measurement and lifecycle summaries\n\nCommand: `bun <tmp>/gb2-summarize.mjs "$PWD"`. function extensionSource(modulePath: string, probePath: string) {
```

```typescript
const path=${JSON.stringify(probePath)};
function save(kind,data){fs.appendFileSync(path,JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\\n');}
export default function(api){

 if(!registry[key]){registry[key]=true;const old=registry.onChange.bind(registry);registry.onChange=callback=>{const observer=new Error().stack?.includes('stock-source.ts');if(observer){shared.active++;shared.peak=Math.max(shared.peak,shared.active);save('listener_add',{active:shared.active});}const off=old(callback);return ()=>{off();if(observer){shared.active--;save('listener_remove',{active:shared.active});}};};}

 api.events.on('task:subagent:lifecycle',fact=>save('lifecycle',{fact}));
 api.registerCommand('gb2inject',{description:'Inject delayed native lifecycle bus evidence',handler:(args,ctx)=>{const facts=JSON.parse(args);for(const fact of facts)api.events.emit('task:subagent:lifecycle',fact);ctx.ui.notify('GB2_INJECT '+JSON.stringify(facts),'info');}});
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

```text
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
```

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url).pathname;
+export function log(kind,data={}){fs.appendFileSync(root+'observer-probe.jsonl',JSON.stringify({kind,atMs:performance.now(),...data})+'\n');}
+export function begin(){return {at:performance.now(),cpu:process.cpuUsage(),heap:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed};}
+export function end(kind,s){const cpu=process.cpuUsage(s.cpu);log(kind,{wallMs:performance.now()-s.at,cpuUs:cpu.user+cpu.system,heapDelta:process.memoryUsage().heapUsed-s.heap});}
+function wrapped(value,kind){if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;return new Proxy(value,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log(kind+'.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});return v.apply(t,args);};}});}
+export const observerFs=new Proxy(fs,{get(t,k){const v=Reflect.get(t,k);if(typeof v!=='function')return v;return (...args)=>{log('fs.'+String(k),{args:args.map(a=>typeof a==='string'||typeof a==='number'?a:typeof a)});const result=v.apply(t,args);return k==='opendirSync'?wrapped(result,'fs.dir'):result;};}});
+export async function observerOpen(...args){log('fs.open',{args});return wrapped(await fs.promises.open(...args),'fs.handle');}
+export function observerServe(...args){log('network.serve');return Bun.serve(...args);}
+export function observerFile(...args){log('fs.Bun.file',{args:args.map(String)});return Bun.file(...args);}
+export function observerFetch(...args){log('network.fetch',{args:args.map(String)});return fetch(...args);}
